objects.name: Analytic 2235
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) requests to an embedded device's management web interface containing exploit-pattern content (oversized parameters, directory traversal sequences) from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) request to device management web interface with exploit-pattern payload from source not in engineering workstation list

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: IP ranges from which legitimate access to the ICS web interface is expected.
Regex/signature set for known exploit payload patterns and published CVE-specific payload signatures for in-use ICS web products.
Time window within which a child shell process spawned from the web server is considered connected to a preceding exploit-pattern request.
